tools.name: rgb-painter-20261012.json
tools.description: Create editable copies of supported Poiyomi materials and enable continuous hue cycling for active color layers. Neutral reflective layers receive color so RGB can appear; original materials and particle renderers are preserved, with visual verification still required.
tools.command_template: Install the reviewed editor source set described in docs/avatar-effects-editor-tools-20261012.md; then open Tools/Unity Unicorn/rgb-painter.
requirements: Unity 2022.3 with the intended avatar project and its legitimately acquired asset dependencies.
Review the source and keep a recoverable project baseline before applying changes.
limitations: Editor source preview; standalone compilation is not Unity or VRChat runtime verification.
Private learned templates, third-party assets and actual use records are not bundled.
